hints.title: Two Subtrees on Any Cut
hints.text: Cutting any edge partitions the tree into two components with sums s and (total_sum - s).

hints.title: Find Total Sum First
hints.text: Run a first postorder traversal to calculate total_sum across all nodes in the tree.

hints.title: Maximize Product Across All Cuts
hints.text: During a second pass, collect every subtree sum s and maximize s * (total_sum - s). Apply modulo 10^9 + 7 at the very end.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing sums from scratch for every edge cut takes quadratic time O(N^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Collecting subtree sums in a single postorder pass enables linear-time product evaluation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate records subtree sums and computes modulo 10^9 + 7 only on the final maximum product.
complexity.notes: Modulo operation must be performed at the very end to avoid maximizing intermediate modular values.

solutions.approach: postorder subtree sum collection and product maximization
